sections.description:
PROTECTION OF COMMUNAL PROPERTIES
PROTECTION OF COMMUNAL
PROPERTIES
OF MINORITIES RULES, 2012
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part II,
2th March, 2012]
S.R.O.
222(I)/2012, dated 1-3-2012. In exercise of powers conferred by section 7 of
the Protection of Communal Properties of Minorities, 2002 (V of 2002), the
Federal Government is pleased to make the following rules, namely:--
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) These rules may be called the
"Protection of Communal Properties of Minorities Rules, 2012".
(2) They
shall come into force at once.
2. Permission
for sale or transfer of minority communities properties.---(1) Any person
intending to sell, purchase, transfer or gift any property shall apply to the
Federal Government, for the grant of NOC, giving all relevant details of
particulars and information, in the form specified in these Rules. Such person
shall also provide any other information or documents as may be required by the
Federal Government for processing of his application:
Provided
that purchase, sale, transfer or gift of such property shall not be used for
fund raising for any project.
(2) The
sale, purchase, transfer or gift of such communal property shall be restricted
only for collective use of community welfare.
Explanation:
For the purpose of this rule, the term "transfer" includes transfer
by way of lease.
(3) The
Federal Government on receipt of an application under sub-rule (1), shall
verify the information and documents of the property through the concerned DCO
and shall invite objections through Press.
(4) The
Federal Government after considering the application and objections, if any,
may give NOC to the applicant on the recommendations of the Commission.
3. Eviction
from un-authorized occupation.---Where any person in possession of the
Property of a Church or Communal authority after retirement or removal from
service of such Church or Communal authority:-
(a) retains
the possession of such property;
(b) refuses
to vacate such property; or
(c) uses
such property for any purpose for which he is not authorized to use,
shall be liable to eviction in accordance with the
law for the time being in force.
4. Rescission.---All
previous notifications issued in this behalf are hereby rescinded.
